site_name: 25 Rose Square, Fulham Road, LONDON, SW3 6RS
description: Removal of skirtings, architraves, doors, joinery cupboards, cornices, plasterboard ceilings, floor finishes, fireplaces and removal of stairs. Provision of a stud partition in kitchen to create a cloakroom, raising of heights of door openings at 2nd floor level, alteration to partitions at 3rd floor level,widening of  doorway into master bedroom, forming of a new opening from master bedroom into dressing room. Provision of new skirting & architraves, new plasterboard ceiling, new fibrous plaster cornices, new joinery cupboards to dressing room and kitchen, new internal doors and new floor finishes. Provision of new stairs, provision of a wrought iron handrail to spiral stairs to turret. Provision of 2 No. new 100mms diameter vent pipes to flat roof. Replacement of rooflights and replacement of electrical & mechanical services.
